diagnosis: The formatter overflowed the default main-task stack at app_main entry before its first log or any SDMMC initialization. The exact ELF prologue allocated 4640 bytes, primarily because FATFS was inlined as a large local object.
remediation: Heap-allocate FATFS and sdmmc_card_t, set and bind a 16384-byte main-task stack, require a small app_main static frame, rebuild reproducibly, and repeat the exact app-only/readback-deferred launch flow.
